text:
maria: noticed a burst of SSE reconnects in eu-west at 10:12 UTC, clients hit immediate reconnect loop after auth handoff during token rotation.
kevin: any logs/traces? resume-token or fresh auth?
maria: mostly resume. proxy logs show ~900ms blocking on keyring refresh then 401->reconnect. snippet:
```
[proxy] 10:12:12 GET /stream resume_id=abc -> 401
[proxy] 10:12:12 keyring refresh (lock)
[proxy] 10:12:13 auth svc validate -> 200
[client] 10:12:13 EOF -> reconnect spam
```
raj: sounds like keyring mutex contention. can we avoid sync refresh on hot path?
sara: short-term: proxy can return 503+Retry-After when rotation-flag set; SDK add jittered backoff; add metric keyring_refresh_block_ms.
kevin: returning 503 affects billing telemetry; we should also implement resume dedupe (3s window) to avoid duplicate billable sessions.
ops-bot: INC-2026-312 created -> assigned kevin.
kevin: plan: feature-flagged proxy hotfix (503+Retry-After=10s) -> 5% eu-west canary, SDK doc update, metric exporter for keyring blocking, dedupe window.
raj: I'll add exporter + dedupe stub. sara: I'll PR proxy change behind flag. maria: update thread with canary graphs.
kevin: watch sse_reconnect_rate, auth_handoff_latency_ms, keyring_refresh_block_ms, billing delta.
